anomalies.observed: The TPS62933 buck regulator U5 has its EN pin (pin 2) left unconnected; the netlist shows only a single no-connect node for U5 pin 2 and no connection to VIN, a pull-up, or any control signal.
anomalies.expected: The EN pin of the TPS62933 must be pulled high (e.g., tied to VIN or through a divider/pull-up) to enable the 24V-to-5V buck regulator. The specification expects U1 (TPS62933) to generate the board's +5V rail.

evidence.quote: U1 — TPS62933 (TI) | 24 V → 5 V synchronous buck regulator, 3 A

anomalies.impact: The TPS62933 will not be enabled, so the +5V rail will never power up. Consequently the +3V3 rail, ESP32-C6, sensors, and all downstream circuitry will be dead. The board will not operate.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a critical open connection: the TPS62933 buck regulator's EN pin is left floating, which prevents the +5V rail from coming up and renders the board non-functional. No other high-confidence anomalies were found.
